function: Joint learning of BS hybrid precoding with TTD units and wideband RIS phase shifts from uplink pilots without explicit CSI, maximizing effective spectral efficiency (p. 2, 7-8).
system: RIS-aided near-field MIMO-OFDM: BS 128 antennas with TTD hybrid precoding, UE 4 antennas, passive reflecting RIS 16x32 (TTD-based or virtual-subarray), 73 GHz, 7 GHz bandwidth (p. 3, 11).
method: End-to-end deep network (polarized self-attention, learnable-DFT blocks, MLP-Mixer) trained unsupervised on negative spectral efficiency with Adam; offline training then online fine-tuning (p. 8-11).
data_channel: Simulated clustered-scatterer near-field wideband channel following the ray-tracing-based model of [23], 3 clusters per link, 73 GHz; no public dataset or measurements (p. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Training: uplink SNR 0-20 dB, downlink 20 dB, UE within 5 m of RIS; testing at 10 and 20 dB unless swept (SNR, bandwidth, distance, RIS setup) (p. 11-14).
baselines: PGDP [37] with an ideal-RIS upper bound, ADPP [14], AMOP [38], all non-learned, using PARAFAC channel estimation for estimated CSI (p. 11-12).
metrics: Ideal and effective spectral efficiency (with training overhead) versus SNR, bandwidth, distance, RIS setup, quantization; validation loss; RIS power consumption (p. 12-14).
complexity: Time complexity orders for the UL-CT and DL-BF modules (for example O(B M_RF Q_tr (7B/4+1))) and space complexity; no measured runtime (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 4: "According to the wideband ray-tracing-based channel model [23]"; p. 11: "In the clustered scatterer channel modeling" with 3 clusters and uniformly drawn angles. A custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 3: "the robustness and generalization of the proposed E2E models are evaluated under various system setups", but the results sweep SNR, bandwidth and distance (p. 12-14) without saying that a model trained in one setup is tested in another. p. 14: "We employ a transfer learning strategy in [33] to train the discrete E2E model" (quantized phase shifts, same channel model).
q3_support: p. 11: the benchmarks are "Projected gradient descent-based precoding (PGDP)", "Alternative delay-phase precoding (ADPP)" and "Alternative manifold optimization-based precoding (AMOP)", all non-learned. No earlier learned beamformer or standard network (CNN, MLP) is compared; TTD-RIS and SA-RIS are both proposed variants.
q4_support: p. 11: "complexity of the PSA-based UL-CE module can be expressed as" an O(.) expression in B, M_RF, Q_tr; orders are also given for the shared network and sub-networks, plus space complexity.
q5_support: p. 11: "In the clustered scatterer channel modeling" shows that the channels are self-generated; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset or measurements.
notes: Included in area 3: end-to-end learned joint BS hybrid precoding and RIS phase shifting with implicit CSI (passive reflecting RIS, TTD-RIS and SA-RIS); the main metric is spectral efficiency, so channel training is not a separate area. q1 is 0 because the channel is a custom clustered-scatterer simulator that follows the model of [23] with its own parameters; the reviewer may check [23]. q2 is 0 because only sweeps and a transfer step for quantized phase shifts are reported. q3 is 0 because every benchmark is a non-learned optimization method.
